channel.title: XKey Updates
channel.description: XKey - Vietnamese Input Method for macOS

item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20260919.1)
item.description:
What's New

fix(xkeyim): inject asynchronously so the IMKit thread stays free

XKeyIM runs its event tap on the main run loop of the process that is also the

active input method, and injectSync blocks that thread for the whole

backspace -> text sequence. The focused app queries this same process through

IMKit for every injected event before delivering it, so WebKit gave up on the

unanswered reply and dropped the event: Vietnamese lost every diacritic in

Safari web fields while physical keys still landed. TextEdit, which does not

wait on the input method that way, was unaffected, and .slow always worked

here only because it was the one method allowed to leave the tap callback.

Give the injector a prefersAsyncDirectInjection flag, wired through

TapEnvironment and set for XKeyIM alone, and let .fast and the empty-char

prefix take the async direct-post path when it is set. XKey.app is not an input

method, so nothing waits on its main thread and it keeps the proxy path

unchanged. The post branches duplicated across four senders move into one

postInjected helper, the injection debug lines name the route they took, and

the unused sendUnicodeCharacter goes.

Safari also reports the focused element of a page as AXWindow or AXGroup for a

moment at a time — observed while typing in a GitHub comment box, where focus

flapped AXTextArea -> AXGroup -> AXWindow without the caret leaving the field.

Both the type-ahead inference and the address-bar cache read such a blink as

"no editable field has focus, so the address bar does" and answered .fast +

needsEmptyCharPrefix, sending a U+202F and one backspace too many into the

page, overriding the user's Window Title Rules along the way. Record when a

real page text field was the confirmed focus and give it a short grace window:

while it holds, the type-ahead inference stays quiet and the cache is dropped

rather than applied. An address bar that identifies itself still wins.

Finally, wire debugLogCallback and verboseEngineLogging in TapController. A

debug log captured while XKeyIM owned the keyboard held focus and

injection-method lines and nothing else, which is why this bug could not be

diagnosed from the log at all.

Build scripts create the DMG with diskutil image create from where that

subcommand exists, since macOS 27 deprecates hdiutil create, and fall back to

hdiutil on systems without it.

Injected events also need .slow spacing on that async route. Posted to the

session tap about a millisecond apart, WebKit applies the second backspace after

the text posted behind it — traced in a Safari textarea, where cos produced

insert U+202F, delete, insert "ó", delete, so the diacritic was removed by the

backspace meant for the character before it. The sleeps cost nothing here

because they run off the tap callback.
